north_star: Make world-class technical judgment reusable, source-grounded, updateable, and executable without reducing experts to role-play.
wedge: A transparent, versioned AI-engineering benchmark that produces one Guru Verdict plus clarification when the council materially disagrees.
target_user: Developers, technical leaders, and AI agents evaluating architecture, implementation, and product-engineering decisions.
core_promise: Turn a technical question or design into a traceable council synthesis, scorecard, disagreement map, and next actions.
product_principles: Evidence before persona: never invent an expert opinion when sources or confidence are insufficient.
Context before consensus: weight advice by domain relevance and the real operating constraints.
Hard failures cannot be averaged away.
Old benchmark snapshots remain reproducible after the living standard evolves.
non_goals: Impersonating living people or generating fabricated quotations.
Declaring one guru universally correct or assigning equal weight regardless of domain.
Shipping a hosted SaaS, model training pipeline, or production evaluator during repository foundation.
success_metrics: A fresh clone can validate all contracts and identify the next claimable implementation task with one documented command.
Every Guru Verdict can identify benchmark version, source cutoff, contributing lenses, confidence, hard-gate state, and disagreement status.
